articles.title: India-US trade deal will protect farmers' interests & sensitive sectors: Piyush Goyal elaborates pact in Lok Sabha
articles.summary: India's long-negotiated trade agreement with the United States is poised to create significant opportunities for Indian exporters and MSMEs. The deal prioritizes safeguarding the interests of farmers and sensitive domestic sectors. This strategic economic pact aims to boost bilateral trade and strengthen India-US economic ties, fostering growth across various industries while maintaining national economic stability.

articles.title: HAL shares tumble 8% after L&T, Bharat Forge get shortlisted to develop fighter jets
articles.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL) shares fell 8.3% on Wednesday. This decline is attributed to market developments involving other key Indian industrial players like Larsen & Toubro, Bharat Forge, and Tata Advanced Systems. The news likely reflects increased competition or new contract awards potentially impacting HAL's market position within the defence sector.
